releases.title: Training intelligence, nutrition-linked quests and measured mobility
releases.summary: Optional exercise swaps, separate warm-up records without XP, one-tap difficulty feedback and an approval-only recovery week. Protein and food quests now use saved Nutrition data. Nutrition logging appears below daily totals. Mobility Skill Tree has measurable reach/ankle tests rather than counted days; old mobility-day credits are archived. Existing SS artwork including the female SS crop top is preserved.

releases.title: SS Masterwork: original avatar-fitted wearables
releases.summary: Replaces SS-only placeholder looks with original black/chrome electric blue-violet artwork for both character wardrobes. Includes five matching categories, new SS wardrobe thumbnails and transparent full-canvas male/female equipped layers. F–S art, mastery requirements and equipment ownership stay unchanged.

releases.title: SS Masterwork equipment and genuine mastery unlocks
releases.summary: Adds SS-tier sunglasses, tops, shorts, shoes and watches to both character wardrobes. S-tier unlocks now require Advanced milestones, while SS-tier unlocks require Mastery and sustained training; previously unlocked S gear is preserved. The new SS tier uses a distinct premium visual finish on the existing body-fitted S silhouettes pending separately approved SS artwork.

releases.title: YOUR PATH branded startup screen
releases.summary: A YOUR PATH loading screen appears immediately instead of a blank white page and fades away once the local interface renders. Uses the existing YOUR PATH mark and preserves THE SYSTEM progression identity. Optional integrations do not block startup; stalled starts offer recovery controls.

releases.title: YOUR PATH: simpler workouts and connected progress
releases.summary: One-tap set saving advances through the workout, unfinished drafts stay safe, previous results and AI ghost targets stay aligned, session editing is consolidated, optional controls sit below workout logging, floating menu avoids focused fields, skill goals are available on demand, cloud drafts can merge independently, and Strava/Oura rate-limit errors trigger automatic backoff. YOUR PATH branding is consistent without changing the existing storage keys or app URL.

releases.title: Faster training, clearer AI and safer logging
releases.summary: Workout logging is now focused on actual weights and reps, with last-session results beside each exercise, clearer validation, Enter-to-next-field, optional automatic AI ghost placeholders, tucked-away display settings and saved-set corrections, and more accurate sync feedback. Existing records and embedded character artwork remain intact.

releases.title: Log sets without tick boxes
releases.summary: AI recommendations appear only as faint ghost placeholders. Entered weights and reps now save as drafts immediately; Save completed sets logs all valid entered sets without ticking. Incomplete sets stay editable and duplicates do not earn XP.

releases.title: Training tab is simpler
releases.summary: Dates now lead straight to the scheduled session. A single Edit Session control replaces confusing duplicates; Add Other Session now handles extra strength and cardio, and the separate Add Cardio section is gone. Existing workout records are preserved.

releases.title: Gold Strength Trials now unlock high ranks
releases.summary: B Rank now needs 1 Gold Strength Trial, A needs 2, and S needs all 4. Bronze/Silver trials alone no longer qualify. Rank progress shows your Gold milestones; existing earned ranks and first-time promotion remain protected.

releases.title: First promotion no longer blocked by rank recovery
releases.summary: New athletes can advance from F to E without an inactivity penalty. Rank decay begins only after a rank has actually been earned; earlier imported training gaps no longer create recovery debt.

releases.title: Character artwork now bundled in the app
releases.summary: All avatar and equipment artwork is embedded inside index.html again. Offline workouts, Analytics and the floating menu remain unchanged.

releases.title: Offline training and deeper Analytics
releases.summary: Workouts remain available offline after the first online setup. Analytics charts strength, cardio and consistency, and the menu button stays visible while scrolling.

releases.title: Smarter coaching and safer saves
releases.summary: Cloud recovery backups, selective automatic merging, Strava/Oura-aware AI coaching, quicker set entry, and adjustable rest timers.

releases.title: Update notifications are here
releases.summary: Future YOUR PATH releases will appear in your Notifications inbox with a brief summary from System Administrator.
